description: This script is designed to process XML test reports for disabled tests, determine flaky and failing tests, and upload the results to an external storage (S3). It includes functions for parsing reports, aggregating test statuses, and managing test re-enablement logic within a workflow context.

methods.name: dict[str,dict[str,int]] process_report( report: Path, )
methods.description: Parses a CSV report XML file to identify failed, skipped, and successful tests, counting occurrences of flaky and failing tests.

methods.name: Generator[Path,None,None] get_test_reports( repo: str, workflow_run_id: int, workflow_run_attempt: int )
methods.description: Yields XML report files from a temporary directory after downloading and extracting artifacts from S3.

methods.name: tuple[str,str,str,str] get_disabled_test_name(test_id: str)
methods.description: Converts a test ID string into a tuple with a verbose name and its components based on a specific naming convention.

methods.name: tuple[Any,dict[str,Any]] prepare_record( workflow_id: int, workflow_run_attempt: int, name: str, classname: str, filename: str, flaky: bool, num_red: int = 0, num_green: int = 0, )
methods.description: Creates a tuple key and a dictionary record representing a test's state for uploading to S3.

methods.name: None save_results( workflow_id: int, workflow_run_attempt: int, all_tests: dict[str, dict[str, int]], )
methods.description: Filters, formats, and uploads test results indicating which tests should be re-enabled and which are flaky.

methods.name: None main(repo: str, workflow_run_id: int, workflow_run_attempt: int)
methods.description: Main execution function that gathers test reports, processes them, and initiates saving results based on test statuses.
